tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the MCP Trust Index for vetted MCP servers. Filter by free-text query (matched against name, publisher, description, and category), category, and/or trust tier. Returns compact records sorted by score. Call with no arguments to list the entire index.

category.description: One of: Database, Developer Tools, File Systems, Search, Productivity, CRM/Business, Cloud, Monitoring, AI/ML

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Full Trust Index record for a single listed server: score, tier, publisher, description with caveats, category, install command, and links. Name is matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: get_rubric
tools.description: The full MCP Trust Index methodology as markdown: the 5 gates every server must pass, the 4 scoring dimensions, trust tiers, and editorial policies.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.description: Servers the Index deliberately does not score: closed-source hosted vendor endpoints and platform-native MCP capabilities (no inspectable code to gate), plus open servers being watched that have not yet passed the gates.

tools.name: get_changelog
tools.description: Public log of every addition, removal, and re-score on the Trust Index, with reasoning.
